correctness.rationale: PASS: From f(x)=||x||^2/2 exact symmetric two-point finite difference gives (u dot x)u and P_u=I-uu^T/d. Since P_u is an orthogonal projection, E||P_u x||^2=(1-1/d)||x||^2 and unique mean-square minimizer eta=1/d follows from 1-2eta+d eta^2. When d odd, integer matrices dI-uu^T are congruent mod 2 to I+J, which is an idempotent nonzero on e_i, precluding finite zero in every sign word; at every Hadamard order a prescribed block of d independent orthogonal rows annihilates all starts with positive independent block frequency. A rank drop by 1 at each stage is necessary for a universal length-d zero product and forces orthogonality. Independently computed exact signed projector products for d=2,4,8 and modular invariants for d=3,5,7. Almost sure convergence follows Markov/Borel-Cantelli; probability-one finite termination follows independent block success, not finite enumeration.
